name: Firestone Ventures Inc.
summary: Firestone Ventures Inc., a junior exploration mineral company, engages in the identification, evaluation, acquisition, and exploration for mineral properties. It explores for precious and base metal deposits. The company was formerly known as Gold Torch Resources Ltd. and changed its name to Firestone Ventures Inc. in December 1999. Firestone Ventures Inc. was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Toronto, Canada.
